credit_line: The Harry B. and Bessie K. Braude Memorial Endowment Fund, 2018.546
description: Depicts Beauford Delaney, an American modernist painter. In this composition, he looks into the distance, smiling slightly. Only his head and the top of his neck have been drawn. The portrait sits at the center of the composition, surrounded by the plain white surface of the paper.
imageCaption: Courtesy of the Art Institute of Chicago.
